- **Role:** music student  <sub>[v3 ch.Christine P15](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Christine Stuart is a tall girl who features large, dark-blue eyes and pale, ivory outlines. Her smooth hair is marked by a distinctive gloss of darkness.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019)_

## History

Before attending a [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) college reception at Patty's Place, Christine Stuart was mentioned by [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as someone [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) had been seeing. During the event, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) observed Christine across the room in Gilbert's company.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/christine-stuart--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was rumored to be romantically involved with Christine Stuart during their time at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While preparing for a reception at Patty's Place, [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) informed [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) had been seeing Christine. Later at the event, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) observed [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in Christine's company across the room, a sight that secretly unsettled her.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), +2 more_
